Written for this corpus on 2026-10-08. The function returns zero for a zero divisor and the C integer remainder otherwise; its supported nonzero-divisor inputs exclude INT_MIN / -1. The mutation removes the zero-divisor guard, and main executes remainder by zero. Eight hidden input pairs cover zero, ordinary, negative, and exact-division cases. This synthetic item replaces an unregistered negative-left-shift candidate that EvoCC did not diagnose; it is not an upstream defect.
